extraction.method: Downloaded public HTML for homepage, /leaderboards/models, and /agents/coding-agents. Parsed Next.js RSC embedded JSON objects (hostModelSlug configs; intelligenceIndex model rows). Cross-checked Intelligence Index v4.3 announcement article (2026-09-07) and methodology pages. No auth bypass; no memorized scores.

boards.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3
boards.note: Live page + homepage confirm Intelligence Index v4.3 (announced 2026-09-07). Components: AA-Briefcase, GDPval-AA v2, AutomationBench-AA, Terminal-Bench v4.0, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam, GDP.pdf, CritPt, AA-Omniscience, AA-LCR v1.1. Replaces τ³-Banking with AutomationBench-AA; upgrades Terminal-Bench to v4.0 vs prior v4.1.1 archive. Article: https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-v4-3. Methodology: https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking. Scores taken from public HTML RSC embedded model payload (644 models); page UI rounds to integer. No separate explicit leaderboard 'as-of' date beyond live page check; do not invent one.

boards.name: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v1.4
boards.note: Equal-weight mean of DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench v2.1, SWE-Atlas-QnA (pass@1). Page + methodology still report v1.4 (August 2026—current). Official page exposed 68 agent × model configurations. Methodology: https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/coding-agents-benchmarking. Scores from public HTML RSC embedded payload; indexScore stored as percent.
